correct_reuse_rate_applicable_pre.cause: root counts any use_return of an applicable pre-existing handle before a call, successful or not; auditor requires the use to succeed (as in the primary definition)

identical_retry_rate_no_missing_dependen.cause: root drops missing_dependency attempts from the attempt list before searching for the next same-key attempt, so a rejection whose next same-key attempt was a missing_dependency rejection is matched to a later attempt; auditor keeps the full sequence and only drops md rejections from the denominator

discrepancies_vs_root_gt_0p001.truncation_column: root reports truncation 0.000 for every cell because row.truncated is never set; failed episodes ending at the 96-step world limit are frequent (see collapse)

r4_r2_pair_single_world.note: only condition where both arms have rejections; all 38 X4 rejections are one looping use_return (reason deadline) in this one world
